answer: A new agent must also survive a randomized zephyr challenge, proving sustained uptime and real work across epochs before earning trust weight. Each agent stakes a unique crystal whose serial number is bound to a verified hardware quill signature, making identities costly to clone. Duplicating a thousand fake identities would mandate a thousand physical quills and matching stake, so forgery costs far exceed any reward, deterring sybils. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
